title: Rav Tuvi son of Rav Ketina
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: He is mentioned in [Niddah 6b](https://www.sefaria.org/Niddah.6b.7). Hyman gives the reading R. M. bar Rav Kisna for [Menachot 76a](https://www.sefaria.org/Menachot.76a.20).[^1][^2]

notes.text: Niddah has Rav Tuvi bar Rav Ketina, as does [Heilprin’s notice](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=1592&lang=en). Menachot has Rav Tuvi bar Kisna speaking in the name of Shmuel.
The Hebrew transcription repeats “but in Menachot” and has the abbreviation ר״מ. The same ruling in both passages makes ר״ט a possible reading.
